# Leslie Moore

## Overview

- **Gender:** Female  <sub>[v4 c11 P42](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0042), [v4 c31 P0](../source/v04-c31.md#nw-v04-c31-p0000)</sub>
- **Role:** Schoolteacher  <sub>[v4 c11 P22](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0022)</sub>

## Appearance

Leslie Moore is a remarkably beautiful young woman who inherited her looks from her mother. She possesses a beautiful and pretty laugh. Under severe emotional strain, she appears pale, quiet, cold, and tired.

_Sources: [v4 c11 P18](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0018), [v4 c11 P19](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0019), [v4 c11 P42](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0042), [v4 c31 P0](../source/v04-c31.md#nw-v04-c31-p0000), [v4 c33 P3](../source/v04-c33.md#nw-v04-c33-p0003)_

## Personality

Leslie exhibits strong resolution, speed, and unswerving determination once she decides on a course of action. Originally bright, friendly, and ambitious as a child, her life's tragedies made her quiet, reserved, and at times icy toward others. She is deeply loyal, clannish regarding her family, and possesses immense pity and compassion for the helpless.

_Sources: [v4 c11 P22](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0022), [v4 c11 P42](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0042), [v4 c31 P0](../source/v04-c31.md#nw-v04-c31-p0000), [v4 c33 P11](../source/v04-c33.md#nw-v04-c33-p0011)_

## Traits

- Resolute and unswerving  <sub>[v4 c31 P0](../source/v04-c31.md#nw-v04-c31-p0000)</sub>
- Bright, friendly, and merry in youth
- Ambitious and intelligent  <sub>[v4 c11 P22](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0022)</sub>
- Clannish and devoted to family  <sub>[v4 c11 P22](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0022)</sub>
- Compassionate and pitying  <sub>[v4 c33 P11](../source/v04-c33.md#nw-v04-c33-p0011)</sub>

## Abilities

- Exceptional academic performance, completing two years of work in one at Queen's Academy  <sub>[v4 c11 P22](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0022)</sub>
- Teaching  <sub>[v4 c11 P22](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0022)</sub>

## Goals

- Earn enough money teaching to attend Redmond College  <sub>[v4 c11 P22](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0022)</sub>

## History

Leslie grew up as her father's favorite and enjoyed a happy childhood until a series of tragic events struck her family. At twelve, she witnessed her younger brother Kenneth get killed by a hay wagon, and at fourteen she discovered her father after he hanged himself in their parlor. Despite these traumas, she pursued her education, completed two years of study in one year at Queen's Academy to earn a First Class license, and secured a position at the Glen school to fund future studies at Redmond College. She was later compelled to marry Dick Moore, but after his voyage on the Four Sisters, Captain Jim brought home an impaired man believed to be Dick, whom Leslie spent years faithfully nursing at her home. When Gilbert Blythe advocated for a medical operation in Montreal to restore the man's memory, Leslie borrowed money from Captain Jim to finance it. The operation successfully restored the man's memory, revealing that he was actually Dick's double cousin, George Moore, and that Dick had died of yellow fever years earlier. After assisting George through his initial recovery, Leslie returned home to Four Winds Point freed from her tragic burden. While Susan Baker was away, she stayed with Anne Shirley at the little house of dreams, where Owen Ford courted her.

_Sources: [v4 c11 P16](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0016), [v4 c11 P20](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0020), [v4 c11 P22](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0022), [v4 c11 P24](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0024), [v4 c31 P1](../source/v04-c31.md#nw-v04-c31-p0001), [v4 c31 P5](../source/v04-c31.md#nw-v04-c31-p0005), [v4 c32 P3](../source/v04-c32.md#nw-v04-c32-p0003), [v4 c32 P6](../source/v04-c32.md#nw-v04-c32-p0006), [v4 c32 P12](../source/v04-c32.md#nw-v04-c32-p0012), [v4 c33 P0](../source/v04-c33.md#nw-v04-c33-p0000), [v4 c33 P5](../source/v04-c33.md#nw-v04-c33-p0005), [v4 c36 P25](../source/v04-c36.md#nw-v04-c36-p0025), [v4 c36 P27](../source/v04-c36.md#nw-v04-c36-p0027)_

## Background by volume

- Inherited her mother's looks, her father's brains, and shared traits with her grandmother West
- Witnessed the tragic death of her four-year-old brother Kenneth at age twelve  <sub>[v4 c11 P16](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0016)</sub>
- Found her father hanged in their parlor at age fourteen  <sub>[v4 c11 P20](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0020)</sub>
- Obtained her First Class teaching license from Queen's Academy and taught at the Glen school  <sub>[v4 c11 P22](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0022)</sub>
